name: fling
description: Publish HTML pages, zips and folders from your computer to Fling and get a link back.
long_description:
Fling hosts static sites at https://<name>.<your sites domain> (private to people signed in to your Fling unless you make them public or share a link).

This extension runs on your computer, so Claude can publish:

- content it created in the conversation (sent inline — no sandbox uploads),
- a file you downloaded or Claude Desktop saved, by name: it looks in Downloads, Desktop, Documents/Claude and Claude Desktop's output folders,
- a single .html file, a .zip of a site, or a folder with index.html.

It works with every Fling you sign in to: the one you downloaded it from is added on start, Claude can sign in to another with the fling_login tool, and the logins are shared with the fling CLI (`fling login <address>`). When several Flings are set up, Claude settles with you which one a conversation uses and names it on every call.
